content.value_statement: Inconsistent test coverage allows regressions to reach users. This skill structures unit, integration, and end-to-end testing with Vitest, Playwright, coverage targets, and CI guidance.
actual_capabilities: Defines a testing pyramid for unit, integration, and end-to-end coverage.
Provides Vitest configuration guidance for React, jsdom, setup files, and coverage thresholds.
Shows unit and integration patterns with React Testing Library and dependency mocks.
Provides Playwright configuration and test patterns for desktop and mobile browser flows.
Outlines test scripts, CI jobs, debugging commands, naming rules, and directory organization.
limitations: The examples primarily target TypeScript, React, npm, Vitest, and Playwright projects.
Project-specific paths, scripts, ports, components, and authentication flows require adaptation.
Test execution depends on the host agent, installed dependencies, and available browsers.
Suggested coverage percentages are general targets, not guarantees of software quality.

use_cases.title: Add tests to a React feature
use_cases.description: Create focused unit and integration coverage for components, interactions, error states, and mocked dependencies.

use_cases.title: Protect critical browser journeys
use_cases.description: Design Playwright tests for authentication, checkout, or other important workflows across desktop and mobile profiles.

use_cases.title: Standardize repository quality gates
use_cases.description: Define coverage thresholds, test scripts, file conventions, and CI jobs for consistent team practices.

prompt_templates.title: Set up basic unit testing
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up Vitest for my React TypeScript project. Include required dependencies, configuration choices, setup files, scripts, and one simple component test.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a project without an established test suite.

prompt_templates.title: Test a feature thoroughly
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a testing plan for [feature]. Separate unit and integration cases, identify mocks, cover success and error states, and suggest clear test names.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for a new or existing application feature.

prompt_templates.title: Design critical E2E coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Design Playwright coverage for [user journey]. Include setup, test data, desktop and mobile projects, stable selectors, assertions, retries, traces, and CI execution.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced browser automation for an important user workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Audit the full testing strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this repository testing approach. Identify coverage gaps, brittle patterns, duplicated effort, missing quality gates, and propose a prioritized unit, integration, and E2E roadmap.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of an established test suite and delivery pipeline.

output_examples.input: Plan tests for a profile component that loads user data.
output: Unit coverage verifies loading, success, empty, and error states.
Integration coverage mocks the user API and confirms rendered profile details.
Assertions focus on accessible text and roles instead of implementation details.

output_examples.input: Create an E2E strategy for sign-up and login.
output: Cover account creation, logout, successful login, invalid credentials, and redirects.
Use isolated test accounts and stable accessible selectors.
Capture traces on retry and run the critical flow in desktop and mobile profiles.

output_examples.input: Recommend CI quality gates for a TypeScript repository.
output_examples.output: Run linting, type checks, unit coverage, and critical Playwright flows. Upload coverage and browser reports for review after failures.

best_practices: Prioritize business logic, edge cases, user interactions, and critical workflows.
Keep tests focused, descriptive, deterministic, and independent from external services.
Use coverage as a gap indicator alongside meaningful behavioral assertions.
anti_patterns: Do not test framework internals, third-party libraries, or trivial generated code.
Do not use vague names or combine unrelated behaviors in one test.
Do not rely on live services, shared state, fixed delays, or unstable selectors.

faq.question: Which test types does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers unit and integration tests with Vitest, plus end-to-end browser tests with Playwright.

faq.question: Does it support non-React projects?
faq.answer: The strategy is adaptable, but many examples use React Testing Library and require changes for other frameworks.

faq.question: What coverage target does it recommend?
faq.answer: It suggests 80 percent for lines, functions, and statements, with 75 percent for branches.

faq.question: Can it configure continuous integration?
faq.answer: It provides a GitHub Actions example for linting, type checks, coverage, Playwright tests, and report artifacts.

faq.question: Will it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: The skill provides strategy and commands. Actual execution depends on the host agent, project permissions, and installed tools.

faq.question: How should E2E tests be selected?
faq.answer: Use E2E tests for critical user journeys. Keep most detailed behavior in faster unit and integration tests.
